name: Normal Framework
description: Work with real building automation systems through Normal Framework. Discovers BACnet, Modbus, and Niagara/Fox devices; searches and trends points; builds Haystack and Brick equipment models; writes setpoints, overrides, and schedules; deploys automation hooks; and diagnoses device health across a single site or a whole portfolio. Use when the question is about a specific building's actual equipment and data — not for general HVAC or protocol explanations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Normal Framework to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Normal Framework to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://portal.normal-online.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Normal Framework MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Normal Framework lists 22 MCP tools, including classify_points, connect, control, delete_points, deploy_hook, diagnose, discover_fox, manage_app, manage_conversions, manage_equipment, manage_hooks, and manage_schedule.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Normal Framework?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Normal Framework in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Normal Framework MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Normal Framework requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Normal Framework is developed by Normal Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
